TEXAS FLOOD DATA DICTIONARY
Consolidated November 10, 2026

1. HOW TO USE THIS DICTIONARY
Section 2 defines every column in image_metadata.csv in file order.
Section 3 lists every original prepared table and its source path.
Section 4 defines their database columns using retained source dictionaries.
Section 5 describes the packaging/support tables.
Read README.txt for loading examples, quality flags, times, datums and reuse.
The full source dictionaries and original README texts are also in SQLite.
Source-specific fields without a standalone definition retain an explicit
source-column reference. Consult that table's original dictionary/document
rather than inferring units or measurement meaning from the column name.

Joins: image_id is unique here; image_key joins original image-level tables.
paired_image_id identifies the companion image; pair_key identifies a pair.
weather_window_id + precipitation_station_id match window_id + STATION
in weather_daily_weather. Use historical_weather_station_id for historical
weather, not automatically precipitation_station_id. Keep hydrology series
and parameter codes alongside site IDs. County GEOIDs are text identifiers.

2. IMAGE_METADATA.CSV (1,204 ROWS; 273 COLUMNS)

image_id
  Unique original image identifier. Primary key in this package.
  Type: string
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

image_path
  Portable path relative to this dataset folder, always images/<image_id>.<extension>.
  Type: string
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

pair_id
  Original before/after pair identifier. Blank for unpaired Hill Country/USCG images.
  Type: string
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

paired_image_id
  image_id of the other image in the same geographic before/after pair; blank if unpaired.
  Type: string
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

image_role
  before or response, as recorded in the original weather image registry. This is not a flood label.
  Type: category
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

image_view_type
  baseline, response, aftermath, or active_flood_candidate; collection role/screening only, not verified ground truth.
  Type: category
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

event_id
  harvey_2017 or hill_country_2025; event association applies to baseline imagery too.
  Type: string
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

event_name
  Human-readable event name.
  Type: string
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

event_start_date
  Event reference date, separate from image acquisition date.
  Type: date
  Unit: YYYY-MM-DD
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

acquisition_date
  Original acquisition/capture date. NOAA mosaic dates identify named flight layers; exact capture time generally unavailable.
  Type: date
  Unit: YYYY-MM-DD
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

capture_time
  Capture time if reported. Blank for all current images; video offset is not a clock time.
  Type: string
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

time_precision
  date_only in this collection; do not interpret image dates as exact UTC timestamps.
  Type: category
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

locality
  Approximate named area. Use bounds for exact georeferenced image footprint.
  Type: string
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

state
  Texas for all images in this package.
  Type: string
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

country
  United States.
  Type: string
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

georeferenced
  true for orthorectified imagery with known bounds; false for the four USCG views.
  Type: boolean
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

latitude
  Image footprint center in WGS84 (EPSG:4326). Blank when exact location is unknown.
  Type: number
  Unit: degrees north
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

longitude
  Image footprint center in WGS84 (EPSG:4326). Negative values are west of Greenwich.
  Type: number
  Unit: degrees east
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

west
  Western image-footprint boundary in WGS84.
  Type: number
  Unit: degrees east
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

south
  Southern image-footprint boundary in WGS84.
  Type: number
  Unit: degrees north
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

east
  Eastern image-footprint boundary in WGS84.
  Type: number
  Unit: degrees east
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

north
  Northern image-footprint boundary in WGS84.
  Type: number
  Unit: degrees north
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

location_precision
  Source description of coordinate/locality precision. USCG positions remain unknown.
  Type: string
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

source_agency
  NOAA, USDA NAIP, or U.S. Coast Guard. Images are aircraft views, not satellite imagery.
  Type: string
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

platform
  Aircraft/helicopter platform description from source; aircraft for orthorectified map imagery.
  Type: string
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

media_type
  Orthorectified aerial image, aerial photograph, or video frame.
  Type: string
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

width_px
  Original image width; copied without resizing.
  Type: integer
  Unit: pixels
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

height_px
  Original image height; copied without resizing.
  Type: integer
  Unit: pixels
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

output_crs
  CRS of the orthorectified image grid (EPSG:3857); coordinates/bounds columns use EPSG:4326. Blank for unreferenced views.
  Type: string
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

native_resolution_min_m
  Source native resolution, or lower end of a source-stated range. Approximate/dataset-level where noted.
  Type: number
  Unit: m/pixel
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

native_resolution_max_m
  Source native resolution, or upper end of a source-stated range. Blank when unknown.
  Type: number
  Unit: m/pixel
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

native_resolution_note
  Basis and limitations of the native ground resolution estimate.
  Type: string
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

output_ground_pixel_spacing_m
  Approximate ground spacing of output pixels; upsampling does not add native detail.
  Type: number
  Unit: m/pixel
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

source_scene_id
  Original flight layer, STAC scene, or DVIDS item identifier.
  Type: string
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

source_url
  Official source item/viewer URL.
  Type: URL
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

source_metadata_url
  Official metadata record or source metadata URL.
  Type: URL
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

source_download_url
  Source download URL, where available. For tiled images see source_tile_urls_json.
  Type: URL
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

source_asset_url
  Original raster asset URL or tile URL template, where available.
  Type: URL
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

source_tile_urls_json
  Original source tile URL list. Parse with json.loads if reconstructing the mosaic.
  Type: JSON array
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

attribution
  Required/requested source credit retained from source records.
  Type: string
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

reuse
  Original recorded reuse terms. See README and source metadata for qualifications.
  Type: string
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

license_url
  Official license/use-terms URL when explicitly available.
  Type: URL
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

processing
  Processing applied during the original collection. Consolidation copies original image bytes unchanged.
  Type: string
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

candidate_condition
  Original screening suggestion, where provided. This is not a verified annotation.
  Type: string
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

screening_notes
  Original visual screening notes; human annotation remains pending.
  Type: string
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

annotation_status
  unannotated in the source collections. Empty label fields below are intentional.
  Type: string
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

flood_visible
  Blank editable human label. Suggested vocabulary: yes, no, uncertain.
  Type: category
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

flood_aftermath_visible
  Blank editable human label. Suggested vocabulary: yes, no, uncertain.
  Type: category
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

annotator
  Blank editable identifier for the person reviewing the image.
  Type: string
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

annotation_notes
  Blank editable notes supporting human labels.
  Type: string
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

dependence_group
  Grouping for correlated images: pair key for Harvey, image footprint for Hill Country, common DVIDS source for video frames.
  Type: string
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

video_offset_seconds
  Offset within the source video, not a capture clock time; blank for still images.
  Type: number
  Unit: seconds
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

source_frame_index
  Zero-based original video-frame index, when recorded.
  Type: integer
  Unit: frames
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

sha256
  SHA-256 of the original image file bytes; verified after copying.
  Type: string
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

image_bytes
  Original file size.
  Type: integer
  Unit: bytes
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

image_key
  Original collection/image_id key for joins to database image-level tables.
  Type: string
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

pair_key
  Collection-qualified pair identifier for preserving before/after groups across dataset splits.
  Type: string
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

collection
  Original collection name, retained for provenance.
  Type: string
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

original_image_path
  Original workspace-relative image path; provenance only. Use image_path to open the supplied image.
  Type: string
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

original_manifest_path
  Original manifest path. Complete original records are retained in database table image_source_metadata.
  Type: string
  Source: Original image manifest; normalized during consolidation

weather_window_id
  Weather window associated with this image; joins to event_windows.window_id.
  Unit: identifier
  Original source table: Texas_Flood_Weather/image_weather.csv
  Original field: weather_window_id
  Notes: Derived by scripts/prepare_analysis.py from source metadata and preserved observations.
  Definition source: Texas_Flood_Weather/data_dictionary.csv

precipitation_mm
  GHCN PRCP on image_date from the nearest eligible daily precipitation station; numeric and blank QFLAG required.
  Unit: mm
  Original source table: Texas_Flood_Weather/image_weather.csv
  Original field: precipitation_mm
  Documentation URL: https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/pub/data/ghcn/daily/readme.txt
  Notes: Trace retains source numeric amount; no substitution of multiday MDPR.
  Definition source: Texas_Flood_Weather/data_dictionary.csv

precipitation_is_trace
  True if selected PRCP measurement flag is T; false for another or blank flag; null if no selected PRCP.
  Unit: boolean
  Original source table: Texas_Flood_Weather/image_weather.csv
  Original field: precipitation_is_trace
  Documentation URL: https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/pub/data/ghcn/daily/readme.txt
  Notes: Derived by scripts/prepare_analysis.py from source metadata and preserved observations.
  Definition source: Texas_Flood_Weather/data_dictionary.csv

precipitation_station_id
  Selected precipitation station identifier; preserve as text.
  Unit: identifier
  Original source table: Texas_Flood_Weather/image_weather.csv
  Original field: precipitation_station_id
  Documentation URL: https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/access/search/documentation/data-service/
  Notes: Nearest eligible station within 100 km; see README for variable-specific eligibility. Caption-only images use named Kerrville regional stations with null distance; these are not distance-ranked scene matches.
  Definition source: Texas_Flood_Weather/data_dictionary.csv

precipitation_station_distance_km
  Great-circle distance from image center to selected precipitation station, rounded to 0.001 km.
  Unit: km
  Original source table: Texas_Flood_Weather/image_weather.csv
  Original field: precipitation_station_distance_km
  Documentation URL: https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/access/search/documentation/data-service/

  Definition source: Texas_Flood_Weather/data_dictionary.csv

preceding_1d_precipitation_mm

  Unit: mm
  Original source table: Texas_Flood_Weather/image_weather.csv
  Original field: preceding_1d_precipitation_mm
  Documentation URL: https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/pub/data/ghcn/daily/readme.txt
  Notes: Same station as selected image-date PRCP. Strictly preceding reporting dates, excluding image_date; no cross-station filling or MDPR addition.
  Definition source: Texas_Flood_Weather/data_dictionary.csv

4. DATABASE FIELD DEFINITIONS
Imported cells use TEXT and preserve empty strings. Convert numeric values
explicitly; never turn an unavailable reading into zero. Source flags and
units are preserved, including fields whose units are carried in another column.


extras_annotation_template
  image_key [identifier]: Unique project image key: collection/image_id.

    Notes: Source CSV cell preserved exactly; empty string means blank. 
    URL: https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/access/search/documentation/data-service/
    Definition source: Texas_Flood_Weather/data_dictionary.csv
  minimum_image_distance_km [km]: Minimum great-circle distance to any precisely georeferenced image center in the window; selection threshold is 100 km.
    Notes: Source CSV cell preserved exactly; empty string means blank. 
    URL: https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/access/search/documentation/data-service/
    Definition source: Texas_Flood_Weather/data_dictionary.csv
  period_start [source date]: Station catalog start of period of record; not a promise of complete daily/hourly coverage. Original catalog date representation retained.
    Notes: Source CSV cell preserved exactly; empty string means blank. 
    URL: https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/access/search/documentation/data-service/
    Definition source: Texas_Flood_Weather/data_dictionary.csv
  period_end [source date]: Station catalog end of period of record; not a promise of complete daily/hourly coverage. Original catalog date representation retained.
    Notes: Source CSV cell preserved exactly; empty string means blank. 
    URL: https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/access/search/documentation/data-service/
    Definition source: Texas_Flood_Weather/data_dictionary.csv
  observed_rows [records]: Number of retained source observations for this station and window; includes ISD summary reports.
    Notes: Source CSV cell preserved exactly; empty string means blank. 
    URL: https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/access/search/documentation/data-service/
    Definition source: Texas_Flood_Weather/data_dictionary.csv
  first_observation [date or UTC timestamp]: First retained reporting date for GHCN Daily, or UTC observation timestamp for ISD, within this window. Blank if none.
    Notes: Source CSV cell preserved exactly; empty string means blank. 
    URL: https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/access/search/documentation/data-service/
    Definition source: Texas_Flood_Weather/data_dictionary.csv
  last_observation [date or UTC timestamp]: Last retained reporting date for GHCN Daily, or UTC observation timestamp for ISD, within this window. Blank if none.
    Notes: Source CSV cell preserved exactly; empty string means blank. 
    URL: https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/access/search/documentation/data-service/
    Definition source: Texas_Flood_Weather/data_dictionary.csv
  available_elements [list/text]: GHCN element codes actually observed in this window; empty list for no observations. ISD entries refer to the source-observation columns instead of enumerating them.
    Notes: Source CSV cell preserved exactly; empty string means blank. 
    URL: https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/access/search/documentation/data-service/
    Definition source: Texas_Flood_Weather/data_dictionary.csv
  retrieval_status [status code]: Collector outcome; downloaded_no_observations means selected but no observations were returned, not zero weather.
    Notes: Source CSV cell preserved exactly; empty string means blank. 
    URL: https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/access/search/documentation/data-service/
    Definition source: Texas_Flood_Weather/data_dictionary.csv
  source_url [URL]: Original NOAA retrieval URL for this row or station selection; identifies the preserved source response.
    Notes: Source CSV cell preserved exactly; empty string means blank. 
    URL: https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/access/search/documentation/data-service/
    Definition source: Texas_Flood_Weather/data_dictionary.csv

5. SUPPORT TABLES
dataset_catalog: one row per queryable CSV-derived table; table_name is its SQL name.
  namespace groups weather/extras/history/images; original_source_path retains provenance.
  row_count/column_count/source_bytes are integers; source_csv_sha256 verifies original bytes.
  imported_cell_sha256 verifies canonical cell content; blank for the new image snapshot.
  source_agency/source_url/time_coverage/description/limitations/join_hint explain the table.
schema_fields: one row per described data column; column_position is one-based.
  table_name and column_name identify the field; storage_type is TEXT for source cells.
  unit, description, source_url, notes and dictionary_source retain definition provenance.
image_source_metadata: one row per image. manifest_json is the original complete image
  record; download_metadata_json preserves supplemental tile/asset details when available.
  image_id/image_key identify the image; original_manifest_path records the original file.
spatial_datasets: one row per original GeoJSON file. source_path is the lookup key;
  source_sha256/source_bytes record the original; feature_count counts included features;
  collection_metadata_json preserves all non-feature top-level GeoJSON members.
spatial_features: one row per GeoJSON feature. source_path joins spatial_datasets;
  feature_index is zero-based original order; feature_id_json, geometry_json,
  properties_json and other_feature_fields_json preserve original JSON members.
binary_assets: one row per retained source/terrain file. source_path is the original
  workspace-relative path; asset_kind and mime_type describe it; source_bytes and
  source_sha256 verify it; content is the original file byte sequence (SQLite BLOB).
source_documents: one row per README/document; source_path, format, source_sha256
  describe the original and content contains its UTF-8 text.
package_info: key/value text records of consolidation counts and validation status.

IMAGE LABEL VOCABULARY
flood_visible / flood_aftermath_visible: suggested yes, no, uncertain; blank = unreviewed.
image_role: before or response; image_view_type: baseline, response, aftermath,
active_flood_candidate. Neither role nor screening suggestion is a human label.
georeferenced: true or false. False does not mean outside Texas; it means exact
image coordinates are unavailable. State/location still follow the official caption.
annotation_status: original status. Update it consistently when adding reviewed labels.

PRECISION AND LIMITATIONS
Image bounds/centers are EPSG:4326; projected image grids use EPSG:3857.
Daily weather labels are reporting days. Preserve source timezones for other datasets.
River stage, coastal MLLW and elevation datums are not interchangeable.
Image-level context represents source-defined matches and can be missing/uncertain.
Read source flags, valid/expected counts, source dates, and spatial alignment fields.
Historical source files can extend beyond prepared table ranges. Raw archives can
contain broader geographic coverage than the prepared Texas-focused tables.
Source copies of image_filename refer to old package paths. Use image_metadata.image_path
for the flat images/ folder. Original raw_file paths identify retained source assets.
No published source measurement or image was changed to create a flood label.
